=== Fair Use ===

{{Feature|quote|You keep using that word, I do not think it means what you think it means|Iñigo Montoya|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}G2y8Sx4B2Sk}}


"Fair Use" is very often called as the ideal line of defense regarding copyright infringement.<br>
Alas for its subscribers, Fair Use most likely means allowed '''''for research and educational purpose''''', under which gaming/modding does not fall.
It is also a '''personal, non-commercial''' "default license" that cannot cover a mod team nor Steam distribution of such work.

For more information, see the Wikipedia articles {{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fair_use}}&nbsp;/&nbsp;{{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fair_dealing}} above.

=== Personal Use ===

"Personal Use", as "Fair Use", is also frequently used to justify illegal IP usage.<br>
Personal use means '''for oneself only'''. Personal use does '''not''' cover group usage (e.g friends, clans), let alone '''reuploads'''.

=== {{arma}} ===

* Data provided in [[Arma Licensed Data Pack]]:
** '''can''' be modified and/or used to make an {{arma}} mod
** '''cannot''' be modified nor used in other games
* Data that is '''not''' listed in [[Arma Licensed Data Pack]] '''cannot''' be modified nor used in any way.

=== {{tkoh}} ===

* Data provided in [[Take On Helicopters Data Pack]]:
** '''can''' be modified and/or used to make an {{arma}} mod (or a {{tkoh}} one)
** '''cannot''' be modified nor used in other games
* Data that is '''not''' listed in [[Take On Helicopters Data Pack]] '''cannot''' be modified nor used in any way.

== Frequently Asked Questions ==

{{Messagebox/BI
| Important:
| Please note that this FAQ is provided '''as an assistance''' and should in no way be considered a legal reference.<br>
{{Name|bi}} '''cannot''' and '''will not''' be held responsible for any license misuse you may commit.<br>
'''You and only you''' will be held responsible for your actions. As a general rule of thumb, '''read and abide by each company's EULA'''.<br>
<br>
'''Use the provided information at your own risk!'''
}}


; {{Color|green|Can I use models from a game of my favourite franchise? I will give credits!}}
: '''Not if these models have been ripped (extracted from the game)
: '''Not without permission''' of both the model's rights owner '''and''' the franchise's intellectual property owner. Giving credits without permission is legally meaningless.


; {{Color|green|All the models are made from the ground up, so I can use the universe of my favourite Intellectual Property, correct?}}
: '''No.''' Using '''copyrighted material''' (the universe, terms, lore) without permission is not allowed. Ask for permission or do not, there is no try.


; {{Color|green|I use models for a free videogame usage, this goes under Fair Use?}}
: '''No.''' In short, Fair Use is valid for a creation's '''criticism''' or '''studying''' and not for public release of any sort. Refer to {{Link|#Fair Use}} to know more about why claiming Fair Use is wrong regarding modding.


; {{Color|green|So, in order to do anything, what do I need?}}
: '''Two''' conditions are required:
:* to have the Intellectual Property owner's '''permission''':
:** the permission can be implicit (the EULA can allow modders to create content without specifically asking)
:** the permission can be explicit (the EULA states that by default no content can be created unless approved)
:* to have models:
:** the models ''can'' come from another game - provided the model rights' owner provided an implicit or explicit '''permission'''
:** the models must otherwise be created from scratch

Anything else is intellectual property (copyright, trademark) infringement.
